titles.title: SCREENS Act
SCREENS Act
Standardizing Cancer Recommendations for Earlier Evaluation and Navigation of Screenings Act

A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to require the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology to establish a national computable-guideline framework for cancer screening recommendations, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
